_meta.digest: sha256 of json.dumps(schema, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) per components.schemas entry of docs/openapi.json
_meta.on_failure: A schema or auth gate licenses vendors changed. In licenses: python3 tests/support/refresh_billing_contract.py (with this repo as a sibling or BILLING_SERVICE_REPO set), commit; then copy that repo's tests/support/billing_contract.json _meta.schema_sha256 list and _meta.write_gates_sha256 here verbatim. Never update this file alone.
_meta.write_gates: write_gates_sha256 = same digest over {"POST <path>": {"dependency": <name>, "roles": [sorted]}} for POST /api/config/markup-rules and /api/config/access-charges, derived from src/routers/config.py + the role constants the dependency reads.
